version: LOCK 58 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - side mission: The overcharging water seller
builds_on: LOCK 34 runner; LOCK 3 and LOCK 6 regulars; River Market places (LOCK 1). Each mission is its own LOCK and queue line.

missions.title: The overcharging water seller
missions.kicker: River Market · The overcharging water seller
missions.button: A water seller is charging travellers double

a.text: It is the hottest part of the day. A water seller at the gate is charging travellers off the road four times the usual price - a woman with a baby can't pay.

choices.label: Buy water for the woman · 2 coins

nasir.text: Nasir the inspector checks the seller's cups and prices and fines him on the spot. The price goes back to normal.

buy.text: The woman drinks and gives the rest to the baby.

out.text: The woman sits in the shade of the gate and waits.

bought: Bought water for a stranger at the gate
